questions.question: Describe how baroque music 1650-1750 are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.

points.text: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use baroque music 1650-1750. Explain the effect in each case.

points.text: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how baroque music 1650-1750 are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use baroque music 1650-1750 in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.

points.text: A practical application showing understanding of how baroque music 1650-1750 can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.
